narrative.gap_prioritization_md: Gaps are prioritized using Zennify's 6-factor framework: Business Impact (25%), Risk (20%), Competitive Gap (20%), Effort Inverse (15%), Quick Win Potential (10%), and Trend (10%). Priority scores range from 1.0 (low) to 5.0 (critical).
